unet2d.name: 2D Dual-Channel U-Net
unet2d.blocks: Double 3x3 Conv2d + BatchNorm2d + ReLU with MaxPool2d(2) and ConvTranspose2d(2)
unet2d.outputs: 2 channels: Channel 0 = Bone marrow, Channel 1 = BME lesion (clipped inside bone at inference)
unet2d.loss: Dice + Focal (bme upweighted for <1% lesion prevalence)
unet2d.gatekeeper: None (inference clips lesion inside predicted bone mask)
unet2d.limitations: 2D slice-by-slice context ignores 3D Z-axis continuity; trained on 18 early annotated cases only.

2d_classifier.name: 2D Slice-to-Case Classifiers (ResNet / ConvNeXt / DenseNet / EfficientNet / MobileNetV3)
2d_classifier.backbone: torchvision 2D CNN backbones (ResNet-18/34/50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet-121, ConvNeXt-Tiny, MobileNetV3)
2d_classifier.blocks: Pretrained ImageNet stem/blocks fine-tuned with patient-grouped 5-fold CV
2d_classifier.input_spec: Extracted 2D MRI slice images resized to 224/256 with optional high-intensity mask & TTA
2d_classifier.outputs: Binary edema presence probability aggregated from slices to patient case score + Grad-CAM heatmap
2d_classifier.limitations: Per-case labels applied to all slices create noisy negative slices inside BME cases; cannot segment or measure lesion volume in mm3; documented shortcut risk on older uncropped JPEGs (docs/STATUS.md).

3d-unet.name: Standard 3D U-Net
3d-unet.blocks: Single or double Conv3d(3x3x3) + InstanceNorm3d + ReLU + MaxPool3d + ConvTranspose3d
3d-unet.outputs: 2 channels: Channel 0 = Bone, Channel 1 = Edema (BME); clipped to bone
3d-unet.loss: Dice + Focal (symmetric Dice on bone and edema)
3d-unet.gatekeeper: None in early runs -> noisy false-positive clusters on negative controls
3d-unet.limitations: Small 96x96x12 field of view (~3-4 cm) lacks pelvic context; without a presence gatekeeper or negative controls in early training, produced high false positives per case.

mednext.name: MedNeXt 3D (MICCAI 2023)
mednext.blocks: 5x5x5 depthwise Conv3d + InstanceNorm3d + 1x1 inverted bottleneck (exp_ratio=2, GELU) + residual projection
mednext.limitations: Tested only in 2-epoch quick smoke test (run_20261031_095628); symmetric 5x5x5 kernel does not model 3.0mm thick-slice anisotropy and lacks C-Net / Bone-Guided Attention.

cnet_dual_unet.name: C-Net + Dual-Channel 3D U-Net
cnet_dual_unet.blocks: Dual Conv3d(3x3x3) + BatchNorm3d (aniso=True: (2,2,1) first pool) + CNetHead3D (AdaptiveMaxPool3d(1) -> FC(64) -> FC(1))
cnet_dual_unet.input_spec: 128x128x16 patches at 0.5x0.5x3.0 mm physical spacing + N4 bias correction + spatial rot/zoom
cnet_dual_unet.outputs: 2 segmentation channels (Bone, BME) + patch C-Net edema presence logit
cnet_dual_unet.gatekeeper: Hard binary cutoff on top-3 patch mean C-Net probability (wiped scans < threshold straight to 0)
cnet_dual_unet.postprocessing: Uniform sliding-window average + flip TTA + hard min_bme_voxels removal
cnet_dual_unet.limitations: BatchNorm3d drifted between train batch=4 and val_batch=8 without gradient clipping, causing Folds 1-4 collapse in Version #41; hard binary C-Net cliff wiped borderline positive scans (12/61 in Version #37) to 0.

orthogate_mednext.name: OrthoGate-MedNeXt3D
orthogate_mednext.backbone: 3-stage anisotropic Encoder-Decoder (20 -> 40 -> 80) + 3D ASPP bottleneck + Bone-Guided Attention + Deep Supervision + CNetHead3D
orthogate_mednext.blocks: 2x _OrthoMedNeXtBlock3D per stage (5x5x3 depthwise Conv3d, GroupNorm, 2x GELU inverted bottleneck, learnable 0.5 res_scale) + aniso (2,2,1) early downsampling + _ASPP3D + _BoneGuidedAttention3D + ds2 aux head
orthogate_mednext.input_spec: 128x128x16 patches at 0.5x0.5x3.0 mm + N4 + spatial rot/scale + MRI gamma/contrast/3D coil shading
orthogate_mednext.outputs: Bone logit, Bone-Gated BME logit, bottleneck C-Net logit, and Stage-2 Deep Supervision aux logits
orthogate_mednext.loss: Asymmetric Tversky (alpha=0.3, beta=0.7 on edema) + AMP-safe FP32 Focal + 0.3 * Deep Supervision loss + 0.5 * C-Net BCE + clip_grad_norm_(1.0)
orthogate_mednext.gatekeeper: Soft C-Net Ramp Gatekeeper across [max(0.05, t_high-0.20), t_high] with train-only calibration (<=0.58, >=92% train sensitivity)
orthogate_mednext.postprocessing: 3D Gaussian center-weighted stitching + 5-fold continuous prob ensemble + intra-osseous 3x3x1 morphological closing + peak-confidence hysteresis (>=25 voxels if peak>=0.65, else >=50)
orthogate_mednext.params_approx: 202,294 params (0.809 MB / fold at bc=20; 3.547 MB 5-fold zip)
orthogate_mednext.limitations: Still constrained by 121-scan single-cohort size (61 BME+), 128x128x16 patch locality, single-modality fat-suppressed MRI without paired T1, 25-voxel floor, and pending real Kaggle 5-fold clinical validation scores.
